title: 第7章 符印实验鹬蚌相争第8章 渔翁得利功法卡
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: 一个小时后！
在山林的一个高坡上，吴语倚靠一块巨石休息。
一路逃亡，后边已经没有什么追兵了，但他还是跑了好一会儿才在这儿休息。
路上杀了十几个砍刀壮汉，击杀后出现的【气血丹】和【兽肉】卡片加起来有四五张。
“用爆率来描述的话，【令人不适的肉块】爆率是最高的，其次是【兽肉】，【气血丹】最次！”
“也是，【气血丹】是唯一的绿色品质，可以提升气血。”
吴语没敢乱吃。
这东西的介绍信息终归与“精致食物”不同，是增加气血，而不是恢复！
在这个古代背景下的【新人秘境】，有【气血丹】，会不会有更好的丹药，甚至能比肩【九龙之力】？
吴语心头微动，拿出青铜凭证，点开了地图。
上边‘恶虎山寨’的标记是一个凶恶的骷髅头，代表了那地方的危险性。
“【新人秘境】有五个撤离点，我这里往那边走都差不多。”
他看了一眼地图。上边会显示自己的动态位置，实时变化。
放在古代，这也算是一件仙家宝物了。
“所以，神秘高塔让我们进入【新人秘境】......”
吴语思考起来，
“将这作为一个游戏看的话，探索秘境，打败敌人，搜刮宝物是主要目的！”
“不，还有迷雾压力。必须赶在迷雾覆盖前进入撤离点！”
“而且......这里不能复活，【新人秘境】说是合作类秘境，会不会有竞争类？而哪怕是新人秘境，也不禁止人互相攻击！”
吴语深呼一口气，并未慌张。
从进入高塔起，他就对其他人抱有一定的提防之心。只可惜柳争身份特殊，吴语隐瞒名字只会适得其反......
“之前他们好像误会了......”
“算了，柳争回去一查，自然知道是自己的问题。”
吴语摇摇头，深思起来。
拥有【毕方符印】，哪怕是如此简陋的条件，吴语一样可以在【新人秘境】中保证自己的安全。
不久前，追杀的一个砍刀壮汉由于隔得比较远，只是被炸成重伤倒地。
吴语便拿他实验了一下，发现了【毕方符印】目前可以在视野内十米范围印刻，
至于印刻条件......一颗石子，一片树叶，甚至是人体都行。
无物不可加，无物不可落！
【毕方符印】悄无声息，可叠加多个。
这个符印目前的杀伤力已经十分可观，但吴语只是一个凡人，一旦回去开始修仙，拥有了灵力，【毕方符印】一定会有更高级的用法。
如修仙百艺中的符箓，如消耗灵力来印刻【毕方符印】，威力想来是不一样的。
他猜测【毕方符印】本就是消耗仙力，灵力的，只不过凡人都没有，所以消耗了一定的气血。
而且有了修仙者的神识，【毕方符印】的范围恐怕会扩大很多，也不用现在这般肉眼印刻了。
“我现在有杀伤力，有恢复药物，满状态下瞪谁谁死！”
吴语心中悄然升起了一丝野心，
在迷雾到来之前，自己是否可以多去杀怪，甚至探索‘恶虎山寨’，‘红坊村’和‘迷途洞’这三个地方，获取更好的东西？
“可以一试！”
“迷雾到来还有很久，我可以多花一点时间去储备【毕方符印】承载物。”
“而且，可以先去‘红坊村’看看，那地方看起来不像是危险地点。”
想到这儿，
吴语看了看物品栏，里边还剩下七个小石子。
若非之前实验花了不少时间，他储备的承载物应该是超过10个了的。
content_en:
An hour later!
On a high slope in the forest, Wu Yu rested against a boulder.
After fleeing all the way, there were no pursuers behind him, but he still ran for a while before resting here.
I killed a dozen strong men with machetes on the road, and after killing them, there were four or five [Qi-Blood Pill] and [Beast Meat] cards in total.
"To describe it in terms of explosion rate, [Uncomfortable Meat] has the highest explosion rate, followed by [Beast Meat], and [Qi-Blood Pill] has the lowest explosion rate!"
"Yes, [Qi and Blood Pill] is the only green quality that can improve Qi and blood."
Wu Yu didn't dare to eat randomly.
After all, the introduction information of this thing is different from "exquisite food". It is to increase Qi and blood, not to restore it!
In this ancient setting of the [Newcomer Secret Realm], with the [Qi and Blood Pill], will there be a better pill, even comparable to the [Power of Nine Dragons]?
Wu Yu's heart moved slightly, he took out the bronze certificate and clicked on the map.
The mark of 'Evil Tiger Village' above is a vicious skull, which represents the danger of that place.
"There are five evacuation points in [Newcomers' Secret Realm]. It's almost the same if I go there."
He glanced at the map. Your dynamic position will be displayed above, changing in real time.
In ancient times, this could be considered an immortal treasure.
"So, the mysterious tower allows us to enter the [Newcomer Secret Realm]..."
Wu Yu thought about it,
"If you look at this as a game, exploring secret realms, defeating enemies, and searching for treasures are the main goals!"
"No, there is still fog pressure. We must enter the evacuation point before the fog covers it!"
"And...resurrection is not allowed here. The [Newcomer Secret Realm] is said to be a cooperative secret realm. Will there be a competitive secret realm? And even in the Newcomer Secret Realm, people are not prohibited from attacking each other!"
Wu Yu took a deep breath and did not panic.
From the moment he entered the tower, he had been wary of other people. It's a pity that Liu Zheng has a special status, and Wu Yu concealing his name will only be counterproductive...
"They seemed to have misunderstood before..."
"Forget it, Liu Zheng will go back and check, and naturally he will know that it is his problem."
Wu Yu shook his head and thought deeply.
With the [Bifang Seal], even with such simple conditions, Wu Yu can still ensure his own safety in the [Newcomer Secret Realm].
Not long ago, a strong man with a machete he was chasing was only seriously injured and fell to the ground because he was far away.
Wu Yu experimented with him and found that [Bifang Sigil] can currently be imprinted within ten meters of the field of vision.
As for the conditions for imprinting...a stone, a leaf, or even a human body will do.
Nothing can be added, nothing can be left behind!
[Bifang Sigil] is silent and can be stacked multiple times.
The current lethality of this talisman is already very impressive, but Wu Yu is just a mortal. Once he goes back to practice immortality and has spiritual power, [Bifang sigil] will definitely have more advanced uses.
For example, the talisman in the Hundred Arts of Immortal Cultivation, such as consuming spiritual power to engrave the [Bifang Talisman], the power is expected to be different.
He guessed that the [Bifang Sigil] originally consumed immortal power and spiritual power, but mortals did not have it, so it consumed a certain amount of energy and blood.
Moreover, with the spiritual consciousness of the immortal cultivator, the range of [Bifang Seal] may be greatly expanded, and there is no need to mark it with the naked eye like now.
"Now I have lethality and recovery medicine. When I'm in full condition, I can stare at anyone to death!"
A trace of ambition quietly rose in Wu Yu's heart.
Before the fog arrives, can I kill more monsters, or even explore the three places of 'Evil Tiger Village', 'Hongfang Village' and 'Lost Cave' to get better things?
"You can give it a try!"
"It will be a long time before the mist arrives. I can spend a little more time stocking up on the [Bifang Sigil] carrier."
"Also, you can go to 'Hongfang Village' first. That place doesn't look like a dangerous place."
Thinking of this,
Wu Yu looked at the inventory, and there were still seven pebbles left in it.
If it hadn't taken a lot of time in the previous experiment, he would have stored more than 10 carrying objects.
